title: 第一卷 第27章 洋人站岗
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
清晨，薄雾笼罩着津门三号码头。

    往日这个时候，码头早就人声鼎沸，号子声震天响。

    今儿个却透着股邪性。

    几百号苦力缩在仓库角落里，眼珠子瞪得溜圆，大气都不敢喘。

    码头入口处，停着三辆黑色的福特轿车。

    车旁，两排印度阿三巡捕荷枪实弹，刺刀在阳光下闪着寒光。

    最扎眼的，是站在最前面的那个白人。

    史密斯探长！

    这位平日里趾高气扬、连总督面子都不给的洋大爷，此刻正黑着一张脸，像尊门神一样杵在码头大门正中央。

    他穿着笔挺的警服，腰杆挺得笔直，只是那双布满血丝的眼睛里，藏着深深的屈辱和恐惧。

    “探长，这......这不合规矩啊。”

    旁边的副手，一个华裔巡捕小声嘀咕道，“咱们是来抓人的，怎么改成站岗了？”

    史密斯嘴角抽搐了一下，手按在腰间的枪套上，指节发白。

    “闭嘴！”

    “让你站岗就站岗，哪那么多废话！”

    他心里在滴血。

    堂堂皇家巡捕房的探长，给一个中国帮派分子看大门。

    传出去，他在租界还怎么混？

    但想起昨晚那个倒挂在天花板上、像恶鬼一样的年轻人，史密斯就觉得脖子发凉。

    那家伙说到做到。

    要是今天自己不乖乖站岗，明天脑袋就被挂在城门楼上。

    命要紧，脸面算个屁。

    ......

    “让开！都他妈给老子让开！”

    一阵嘈杂的叫骂声从街角传来。

    十几辆黄包车拉着人，风风火火地冲了过来。

    为首的一辆车上，坐着个干瘦老头。

    穿着灰布长衫，手里盘着两颗核桃，眼神阴鸷。

    漕运商会的大管事，沈玉楼。

    魏兴死了，漕运商会的财政瞬间崩塌。

    大会长气得当场掀桌子，二会长差点带人提刀要和海河帮火拼。

    这个时候，沈玉楼觉得该是自己来撑场子了。

    带了上百号打手，准备来海河帮要个说法。

    魏兴的死与海河帮，或者直接说与陆川必然脱不开关系！

    不管如何，今天必须要海河帮的人血债血偿！

    结果刚到码头，就被拦住了。

    “哟，这不是沈管事吗？”

    史密斯皮笑肉不笑地迎了上去，挡在路中间，“今儿个这码头，巡捕房接管了。”

    “谁也不许进。”

    沈玉楼愣了一下，随即冷笑一声。

    “史密斯探长，你脑子进水了？”

    “这码头是漕运商会的产业，什么时候归你们巡捕房管了？”

    “少他妈挡道，老子今儿个是来平事的！”

    沈玉楼一挥手，身后的打手们抽出哨棒、砍刀，就要往前冲。

    “我看谁敢动！”

    史密斯猛地拔枪。

    “砰！”

    一枪打在孙瘸子脚边的青石板上，碎石飞溅。

    全场瞬间死寂。

    沈玉楼的脸瞬间绿了。

    “史密斯！你疯了？你敢冲我开枪？”

    “我是商会的人！洋行的大股东你也敢动？”

    史密斯面无表情，枪口上抬，直指沈玉楼的脑门。

    “沈，你是觉得我不敢吗？”

    “要不要试试？”

    沈玉楼浑身一哆嗦。

    他看着史密斯那双布满血丝、透着疯狂的眼睛，信了。

    这洋鬼子不像是在开玩笑。

    “你......你被那个陆川收买了？”

    沈玉楼咬牙切齿道，“为了个中国人，你连洋人的脸都不要了？”

    “脸？”
content_en:
In the early morning, mist enveloped Jinmen Pier 3.

    At this time in the past, the pier was already bustling with people and chants were loud.

    Today, there is an evil nature in this person.

    Hundreds of coolies huddled in the corner of the warehouse, their eyes widened and they didn't dare to breathe.

    There were three black Ford cars parked at the entrance of the pier.

    Next to the car, two rows of Indian Asan police officers were armed with live ammunition, their bayonets gleaming coldly in the sun.

    The most eye-catching thing is the white man standing at the front.

    Detective Smith!

    This foreign man, who was usually arrogant and did not even give the governor face, was standing in the center of the dock gate with a dark face at the moment like a door god.

    He was wearing a straight police uniform and his waist was straight, but there was deep humiliation and fear hidden in his bloodshot eyes.

    "Detective, this...this is against the rules."

    The deputy next to him, a Chinese patrolman, muttered in a low voice, "We are here to arrest people, why did we change to standing guard?"

    The corner of Smith's mouth twitched, his hand pressed on the holster on his waist, his knuckles turning white.

    "Shut up!"

    "Just stand guard when I ask you to do so, there is so much nonsense!"

    His heart was bleeding.

    A dignified detective from the royal patrol house showed a Chinese gang member the door.

    If word spreads, how can he still hang out in the concession?

    But thinking of the young man hanging upside down from the ceiling like a ghost last night, Smith felt a chill on his neck.

    The guy means what he says.

    If I don't stand guard today, my head will be hung on the city gate tower tomorrow.

    Life is important, face is nothing.

    ...

    "Get out of the way! Get out of my way!"

    A loud shouting came from the street corner.

    More than a dozen rickshaws rushing over with people in tow.

    In the leading car, there was a skinny old man sitting.

    Wearing a gray cloth gown, he held two walnuts in his hand and had a sinister look in his eyes.

    The chief executive of the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce, Shen Yulou.

    Wei Xing died, and the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce's finances collapsed instantly.

    The president of the conference was so angry that he flipped the table on the spot, and the second president almost brought someone with a knife to fight with the Haihe Gang.

    At this time, Shen Yulou felt that it was time for him to support the scene.

    He brought hundreds of thugs with him and prepared to come to the Haihe Gang to demand an explanation.

    Wei Xing's death must be closely related to the Haihe Gang, or directly to Lu Chuan!

    No matter what, today the Haihe Gang must pay with their blood!

    As soon as we arrived at the pier, we were stopped.

    "Hey, isn't this Manager Shen?"

    Smith walked forward with a smile and stood in the middle of the road, "The patrol house has taken over this dock today."

    "No one is allowed in."

    Shen Yulou was stunned for a moment, then sneered.

    "Detective Smith, are you out of your mind?"

    "This wharf is the property of the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce. When did it come under the control of your patrol office?"

    "Don't get in the way, I'm just here to make things right!"

    Shen Yulou waved his hand, and the thugs behind him took out whistle sticks and machetes and rushed forward.

    "Let's see who dares to move!"

    Smith jerked his gun.

    "Bang!"

    A shot hit the bluestone at Sun Laizi's feet, causing gravel to fly.

    The whole place fell silent for a moment.

    Shen Yulou's face instantly turned green.

    "Smith! Are you crazy? Do you dare to shoot me?"

    "I'm from the Chamber of Commerce! How dare you touch the major shareholder of a foreign company?"

    Smith's face was expressionless, the muzzle of the gun was raised, pointing directly at Shen Yulou's head.

    "Shen, do you think I dare not?"

    "Want to try?"

    Shen Yulou trembled all over.

    He looked at Smith's bloodshot, crazy eyes and believed it.

    This foreign devil doesn't seem to be joking.

    "You...were you bribed by that Lu Chuan?"

    Shen Yulou gritted his teeth and said, "For the sake of a Chinese, you don't even want to give up the face of a foreigner?"

    "Face?"
